source.claimText: A compound having the following structure (II): [chem] or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, tautomer or stereoisomer thereof, wherein: R10 and R11 are each independently a straight, saturated alkyl chain containing from 12 to 16 carbon atoms; and z has a mean value ranging from 30 to 60.

vars.name: z
vars.quote: z has a mean value ranging from 30 to 60
vars.note: z is a mean value of a polydisperse PEG; a single molecule is checked against the range.

vars.name: R10
vars.quote: R10 and R11 are each independently a straight, saturated alkyl chain containing from 12 to 16 carbon atoms

vars.name: R11
vars.quote: R10 and R11 are each independently a straight, saturated alkyl chain containing from 12 to 16 carbon atoms

ref.name: ALC-0159
ref.note: z = 45 (PEG 2000), R10 = R11 = n-tetradecyl; the molecule is one member of the PEG distribution
